title: Introduce adaptive color harmonics and micro-typography for dense analytics surfaces
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Rationalize and introduce a new set of adaptive color harmonics, an offset micro-typography scale, and compact spacing/radius presets for high-density analytics surfaces (tables, small charts, and compact widgets). Goal is to improve legibility at small sizes, reduce visual noise in dense data grids, and provide a deterministic migration path for existing token consumers.
scope: Create harmonic color generator and export as semantic tokens (accent/neutral/surface/interactive)
Define micro-typography scale: -2, -1, 0 and clear usage guidelines for labels, axis, and microcopy
Introduce compact spacing and radius presets for dense tables and small cards
Rework elevation/shadow presets to a flatter, contrast-driven micro-elevation system for small surfaces
Provide migration guide, codemods, and Figma components to support rollout
acceptance_criteria: Semantic color token set exported and validated in Figma with 4 sample dashboards
Micro-typography CSS variables published and integrated into component library (table rows, chart labels, buttons)
Compact spacing/radius tokens implemented in Storybook variants for tables/charts/buttons and pass visual QA
Shadow/elevation presets adjusted and verified against contrast/a11y checks for small surfaces (AA for text over surfaces)
Migration guide published with example codemod and risk matrix; no blocking regressions in top 10 production dashboards after canary rollout
design_notes: We will use a perceptually-uniform harmonic generator to derive accent ramps from a single seed to preserve brand hue while producing neutral-friendly variants.
Micro type will rely on font-feature settings (optical sizing) where available and fallback scale uses letter-spacing + weight adjustments to maintain legibility at 11–12px equivalents.
Elevation will move from large soft shadows to proportionally smaller ambient+umbra pairs with emphasis on contrast rather than depth for tiny surfaces.
Spacing and radius presets prioritize touch targets on interactive dense rows; compact tokens should still meet 44px minimum tap area by allowing row-level expansion settings.
Plan to deprecate six legacy color tokens and provide aliases to avoid breaking changes for 90% of usages.

risks: Risk: Small-type legibility on lower-density screens — mitigated by weight/spacing adjustments and opt-in expansion setting.
Risk: Runtime token mapping could introduce transient visual churn for customers — mitigated by canary rollout and aliasing legacy tokens.
Risk: Charts with hard-coded color references may require manual updates — plan includes a migration checklist and QA for top 10 dashboards.
